stated: The Conservative Party will pass a new law in the first session of the next Parliament to provide better treatment and support for severe mental health needs.

source.quote: Pass a new law to provide better treatment and support for severe mental health needs in the first session of the next Parliament.

bearing_set.reason: A new mental health law directly targets access to treatment and support for severe mental health conditions, bearing materially on healthcare access under O3.

Any new Mental Health Act in the UK inherently governs compulsory detention and treatment without consent; the direction (expanding or restricting coercive powers, changing detention criteria) directly moves the bodily autonomy and freedom-from-state-coercion indicators under O10.

membership_note: Primary bearing is O3 (mental health treatment access); secondary bearing is O10 because UK mental health legislation structurally governs compulsory powers. Other fundamentals (O12, O9, O13) are too speculative given the policy's vague stated form to clear the non-negligible threshold.
